source_row.extraction_instructions: BAAPS /about/events is a calendar of many events, not one congress, so this is a bespoke extractor on the rcpath.py pattern (single_congress family does not fit). Walks /about/events/date/<YYYY>/ for this year and the next two (div.date_row cards), keeps unfinished events whose page is plastic/aesthetic-surgery related or organised by BAAPS (the calendar also carries unrelated nursing/healthcare promoter listings), then reads each detail page. Fees come from the organiser's own site JSON-LD where linked; BAAPS-booked events are behind login. Organiser fees: only the anchors labelled 'Book online for this event' / 'Further details about this event' are followed (never the first external href), URL checked with safe_fetch.check_url_safe, JSON-LD offers sanity-checked (0-10000, GBP/EUR/USD, label <=120 chars).
